Noah Rivera: Cascade BI SOW back w/ asks: 50% off first month, waive onboarding, and Net60. Can we approve?

Priya Singh: Finance policy: >40% discounts need deal desk + VP-Finance. Net60 on new accounts requires PO and credit holdback. Who owns the account?

Noah Rivera: Owner: Noah (AE). Pilot 1mo, est 25M tokens, low immediate ARR but strategic analytics use-case. Customer prefers simple percent to avoid invoice credits.

Hannah Lee: Ops: we prefer one-time onboarding credit instead of changing invoice line items. That keeps revenue clear. Also, waiving onboarding fee entirely bumps up credit risk.

Priya Singh: Suggested counter for deal desk:
```
Item: Pilot (25M tokens) - list $2,500/mo
Requested: 50% off month 1, waive $4k onboarding, Net60
Finance counter: 40% off month 1, $2k onboarding credit (contra), Net30. Require PO for Net60 or VP-Finance sign-off.
```

Noah Rivera: Sales can accept 40% + $2k credit if it closes. I'll push customer for PO and Net30.

approvals-bot: Approval ticket APP-5099 created and assigned to Priya Singh + VP-Finance. Summary: Cascade BI pilot pricing exception (50% + waive onboarding + Net60). Link: https://internal/approvals/APP-5099

Priya Singh: Logging this for deal desk review. If VP-Finance approves Net60, Collections will set a $20k credit cap and 60-day review.

Noah Rivera: Thanks team 60a; holding signature until APP-5099 resolved.
